reviewer: Primary visual review with three independent blind axis reviews

directions.observed: Front head pitched up; chin and gaze raised.
directions.reason: Eyes sit high on the face and the lower cheek/chin plane opens upward.

directions.observed: Head turns slightly right while retaining upward pitch.
directions.reason: Face and eye landmarks shift right relative to the torso; chin remains raised.

directions.observed: Rightward head turn with an elevated gaze.
directions.reason: Right-facing cheek and nose position combine with raised eyelids/face plane.

directions.observed: Rightward turn dominates; upward component is shallow.
directions.reason: Head/iris position remains above the level-right anchor; adjacent step is small.

directions.observed: Head and eyes clearly face screen-right.
directions.reason: Nose and face surface point toward the right while the torso stays planted.

directions.observed: Rightward head with a slight downward pitch.
directions.reason: Eye line and chin lower relative to the right cardinal; the down component is mild.

directions.observed: Head faces right and tilts down.
directions.reason: Face shifts right while eyelids and chin turn toward the lower-right.

directions.observed: Strong downward pitch, nearly front-facing; rightward bias is very subtle.
directions.reason: Labeled loop approaches the down cardinal from the right without reversing. The small face offset is difficult to identify alone; all three blind reviewers marked the horizontal axis ambiguous.

directions.observed: Front head bowed, gaze clearly down.
directions.reason: Lowered eye line and tucked chin clearly distinguish it from the up cardinal.

directions.observed: Downward head with a slight leftward turn.
directions.reason: Face begins shifting left from the down anchor; horizontal movement is subtle.
Leftward face offset and lowered eyelids combine into a lower-left gaze.

directions.observed: Leftward head turn with a mild downward pitch.
directions.reason: Nose faces left; chin and eye line remain slightly below the left cardinal.
Nose points left and the far eye is naturally occluded; boots and torso remain front-facing.
Head and nose aim left while the lifted face plane and eyes aim upward.
Head begins returning toward front while maintaining leftward nose/iris displacement and raised chin.

directions.observed: Nearly front-facing upward gaze with a small leftward bias.
directions.reason: Raised eye line and chin continue toward the up anchor; a slight left face offset remains and is subtle.

continuity_review: Planted torso and boots remain stable. The 135 to 157.5 head return is a larger discrete step, without reversal. Open cyan halos create intentional transparent gaps above the ears; no missing face/body regions were observed.
